historical_references.reference: Imtiazat was the name of a powerful Turkish slave general under the Mamluk Sultan Qansuh al-Ghuri. He led the Mamluk forces against the Mongol invasion in 1516 CE.

The name Imtiazat is also mentioned in the Persian poetry of Amir Khusrow, a 13th century poet and musician in the Delhi Sultanate. It is used to describe a divine quality or attribute, often translated as 'distinction' or 'excellence'.
